requirements: Invocation argument expressions are values of input parameters through FeatureValue relationships.
Function/type binding, parameter redefinition, result specialization and behavior binding connectors are additional semantic obligations; creating argument ownership does not satisfy them.
Ordinary operator expressions represent invocation of the function identified by their operator symbol.
Control-function expression parameters require body-expression handling rather than ordinary eager-argument construction.

pilot_boundary: InvocationExpression.operand is a Pilot Ecore/Xtext parsing extension. Its append-only adapter constructs private ParameterMembership -> input Feature -> FeatureValue -> argument Expression. Its getter facade reports no elements and is not the normative argument derivation.
decision: Explicit handwritten Rust construction, parameterized by imported Ecore contracts and guarded by the imported setting-delegate identity. No Xtend translation: the necessary dependency is Java model-adapter code.
verification_scope: Initial fresh-operand attachment with ordered stored ownership, wrapper kinds, direction and visibility. Bounded literal/unary/eager-binary invariant-result production emission. No general getter, argument derivation, full expression/action translation or reparenting qualification.
